thread:
Jess L.: heads-up: we've got a small wave of issues from the rollout + a few enhancement asks from alpha customers. want to align on which items are hotfixes vs queued enhancements. quick sync? :timer_clock:
Mike R.: +1. can we get the raw list and customer impact buckets?
triage-bot: new items added to #support-fanout: 6 issues, 3 feature-requests (see links)
Raj P.: I skimmed — two P1 regressions: streaming disconnects and a memory leak in kv-cache eviction. both cause customer-visible failures.
Sophia M.: memory leak definitely needs a patch release, streaming disconnect depends on load pattern. has anyone reproduced in staging?
Mike R.: I reproduced streaming drop under burst > 200 rps on g4dn; stack looks like backpressure + socket close. patch idea: bump socket keepalive + surface better client retry guidance.
Jess L.: proposal: classify leak + streaming disconnect as hotfixes (ship in next patch); remaining items (UI tweaks, docs, model-variant request) = enhancements for next sprint. thoughts?
Oliver T.: agree on prioritization, but the model-variant request came from 2 paying customers asking for lower-cost quantized variant — revenue signal there. can we split actionable bits: quick docs + roadmap note now, deeper work in next cycle?
Raj P.: fine with that split. hotfix plan: 1) memory leak unit test + revert risky alloc change 2) streaming backpressure mitigation + client retry guidance. estimate 2 devs x 3 days for both.
Jess L.: can we get a canary plan? Mike, can you draft steps (regions, % traffic, rollback conditions)?
Mike R.: will do. rough canary: deploy to dedicated-canary cluster, route 5% of internal traffic for 6 hrs, check error rate, tail-latency, and memory growth. rollback if error rate > baseline + 1%.
Sophia M.: ops: please add monitoring for kv-cache mem delta and socket close counts. also add an alert if pomerium connection errors spike.
Oliver T.: i'll loop in acct execs to temper customer expectations (ETA: patch next week + follow-on roadmap item).
Jess L.: for enhancements: let's batch the docs edits + low-risk UI fixes for next sprint grooming. create GH label "post-launch-iter-1" and move issues there.
triage-bot: created label post-launch-iter-1 and moved 5 issues.
Raj P.: one more ask: can product prioritize a small eval harness for quantized model perf? adds clarity to cost tradeoffs. estimate 2-3 days of infra/bench work.
Jess L.: acknowledged. i'll slot that as a medium priority enhancement — we'll try to include if hotfix work finishes early. thanks all, i'll follow up with a short plan + owners in this thread. :thumbsup:
Mike R.: ping me when you add owners, i'll start the canary doc and PR for fixes.
Oliver T.: noted, i'll draft customer comms template.
Jess L.: closing action items: Jess -> owners + plan by EOD, Mike & Raj -> hotfix PRs, Sophia -> monitoring + alerts, Oliver -> customer comms. keep updates here.
